title: Cloudflare Releases Clef-omni: A 30B-A3B Multimodal Decision Model
summary: Cloudflare has introduced Clef-omni, an open-weight mixture-of-experts decision model capable of scoring text, images, audio, and video in a single API call. By moving its serving stack to SGLang, Cloudflare also doubled hosted inference speeds for the Clef model family.

whyItMatters.text: Clef-omni is a 30B total / 3B active parameter MoE built on Qwen3-Omni, priced at $0.15 per million input tokens.
Accepts up to 4 images, 4 audio clips (300s each), and 2 video clips (60s each) with a 64k-token context window.
Leads intent classification benchmarks like CLINC150+OOS (97.7 macro-F1), but trails on hard reasoning and workflow tasks.

articles.headline: Cloudflare Releases Clef-omni: A 30B-A3B Multimodal Decision Model
articles.summary: Cloudflare has introduced Clef-omni, an open-weight mixture-of-experts decision model capable of scoring text, images, audio, and video in a single API call. By moving its serving stack to SGLang, Cloudflare also doubled hosted inference speeds for the Clef model family.
key_takeaways: Clef-omni is a 30B total / 3B active parameter MoE built on Qwen3-Omni, priced at $0.15 per million input tokens.
Accepts up to 4 images, 4 audio clips (300s each), and 2 video clips (60s each) with a 64k-token context window.
Leads intent classification benchmarks like CLINC150+OOS (97.7 macro-F1), but trails on hard reasoning and workflow tasks.

articles.headline: vLLM Semantic Router Drops Decision 3.0: Five Multimodal Models
articles.summary: The vLLM Semantic Router team has released Decision 3.0, featuring five Apache-2.0 models ranging from 0.8B to 27B parameters. These models output calibrated probabilities instead of generated text, serving as low-latency routers and guardrails.
key_takeaways: Models span sizes from 0.85B (d3-lite) to 26.09B (d3), all featuring native vision encoders handling up to 1.6-megapixel inputs.
The 9B d3-flash model (59.0 index score) outperforms the previous generation's 27B model (55.9).
Median text latencies range from 21.7 ms to 84 ms when measured on a single AMD Instinct MI325X GPU.

articles.headline: OrcaRouter Launches OrcaCyber Zero 1.5 with 1M-Token Context
articles.summary: OrcaRouter has debuted OrcaCyber Zero 1.5, a post-trained model specialized for vulnerability reproduction, exploit development, and penetration testing. It features a 1-million-token context window and is available via an OpenAI-compatible API.
key_takeaways: Reports 100% on Cybench (39/39 tasks) and 95.8% on a 24-task evaluable subset of CVE-Bench under unrestricted agent execution.
Priced competitively at $3.00 per million input tokens and $7.50 per million output tokens.
Access is strictly gated to vetted security researchers and red teams under a specialized Security Research tier.

articles.headline: DHH's Campfire Rewrite Proves AI Doesn't Eliminate Architecture Trade-offs
articles.summary: A deep technical analysis of DHH's AI-generated rewrites of Campfire Once in Rust and Elixir reveals critical failure modes in concurrency and load handling. The experiment demonstrates that developers must still deeply understand system trade-offs, failure modes, and constraints.
key_takeaways: The Rust version suffered a 1% notification delivery rate under heavy load due to a default broadcast channel capacity limit of 256.
Increasing channel capacity to 16,384 raised delivery to 90%, but pushed pMax latency past 130 seconds, showing that failing fast is often superior to unbounded queuing.
Single metrics (like raw throughput) obscure vital system characteristics, such as backpressure handling, memory usage, and client timeout behavior.
